## Observational audit

**Outcome.** The K2_v1 selection run completed normally (`end_turn`) and the official verifier reported reward 1, F2P 66/66 and P2P 30,014/30,014. This is full success on the reported verifier, not a claim about untested uses. The local full-suite attempt did not complete; it is separate from the later official evaluation. No B0 run was supplied, so no baseline comparison or knowledge-adoption claim about B0 is possible.

**Sources.** The supplied trajectory is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_followup_20261126_182329/runs/capability_followup_v2_selection_mashumaro-flattened-dataclass-fields_K2_v1_r1/infer_logs/mashumaro-flattened-dataclass-fields/turn_1/trajs.json`; the loaded capability source is its sibling `loaded_capabilities.md`. The official result is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_followup_20261126_182329/runs/capability_followup_v2_selection_mashumaro-flattened-dataclass-fields_K2_v1_r1/eval_output/mashumaro-flattened-dataclass-fields/eval_result.json`. All event IDs below are `main_agent` IDs. The supplied loaded text establishes four capabilities were present, not that they caused the student’s actions.

### Exploration and changes

The student created the requested branch from `main` and inspected the repository, field metadata, generated pack/unpack machinery, and nested dataclass handling (events 1–12, 15–22). A pre-change executable probe showed `flatten=True` still produced `{'child': {'x': 1}}` rather than a merged key (13–14).

The final patch changed `/app/mashumaro/helper.py` and `/app/mashumaro/core/meta/code/builder.py`. It added flatten, prefix and rename options; generated mappings for nested fields, aliases and strict-key input; checked types, collisions and rename constraints; and added pack/unpack paths. It also handled optional children and defaults. These are patch observations, not independent proof of every edge case. The branch was committed as `8c25af3` (111–112).

The first helper edit would have added default metadata keys, contrary to the existing exact-dictionary contract in `tests/test_helper.py`; after inspecting that contract, the student made those keys conditional (23–33). An optional/strict-alias probe then failed with an `AttributeError` (65–66); moving generated reconstruction into the field block was followed by a passing probe (67–70). A renamed strict-child alias round trip failed with `ExtraKeysError` (79–80); separate input mappings were added and the probe passed (81–94). A default-factory probe returned the child’s default rather than the parent factory’s value (103–104), prompting another edit (105–107); the same default-factory probe was not visibly rerun. These are observed intermediate regressions and repairs, not evidence of an unseen final failure.

### Validation, limitations and cost

Local checks included basic and multiple-child round trips, optional/prefix/strict-key and renamed-alias probes, import checks and `git diff --check` (48–56, 65–72, 93–104). The final available focused run reported 33 passed and three deselected (109–110). Local full collection stopped on missing optional dependencies, including `orjson` and `tomli_w` (57–59); other attempts exposed missing `ciso8601`, `yaml`, and the `mocker` fixture (61–64, 106–108). The student’s final statement at 113 accurately presents these as local limitations, not official results.

The independent official record reports exit code 0, no verifier timeout, and the F2P/P2P totals above. Its displayed raw new suite reports 72 passed and a raw preservation suite tail reports 30,008 passed; the grader’s classified totals are the authoritative reported F2P/P2P counts and should not be substituted with those raw counts.

There was some extra work: several similar basic round-trip checks were repeated after earlier passes (95–102), and event 75 attempted an identical-string edit, rejected as a no-op (78). Checking an unavailable formatter also consumed a call (97–98). These costs cannot be isolated from useful edge-case exploration. The run requested and received 56 tool calls, used 33 model requests, 1,969,109 input and 7,801 output tokens, and had 2,591.992 seconds end-to-end wall time; verifier elapsed time was 1,633.513 seconds. SDK `total_cost_usd` was approximately $10.04 as a **proxy estimate**, not actual CLI billing; no actual dollar fee is reported. The 1,800-second student budget did not produce a budget stop: the recorded stop was normal completion.

### Capability evidence

The student did not expressly claim to follow any loaded capability. The following assesses executable behavior, not adoption; an ordinary base student could perform the same work. Some read and edit outputs, including the initial builder read and event 41 edit, are truncated, so their full contemporaneous contents cannot be assessed from those events alone; the supplied final patch provides the final changes.

| Capability/theme | Observed action and event IDs | Inference limits |
|---|---|---|
| Inspect state across transitions | Compared serialized dictionaries with deserialized objects, including optional and renamed strict-alias cases (65–70, 79–94). | Consistent with checking a producer/consumer boundary; no direct inspection of every generated consumer input. Truncated builder output limits reconstruction of initial inspection. |
| Check identity and failure feedback end to end | Observed and repaired distinct `AttributeError` and `ExtraKeysError` failures (65–70, 79–94). | Failure differentiation is relevant, but request/response identity, unknown targets and repeated delegation cycles were not applicable or demonstrated. No adoption claim. |
| Carry input contracts into later use | Inspected the helper’s exact metadata contract (27–33); added alias-aware input mapping and strict-key handling (81–94). | Directly consistent with names and input contracts; not a system learning and persisting a schema. The default-factory correction lacked a visible exact-probe rerun. |
| Preserve meaning when changing representation | Reproduced nested output, then tested flatten round trips and existing regressions (13–14, 48–56, 93–94, 109–110). | Consistent with semantic preservation under serialization. No idempotence check or completed local full suite is visible; official success is separately reported. Truncated reads prevent assessing all exploration. |
